High, tb/floor2 b8e9112a6, phase2_capture_routes.gd --biome=meadows --seed=2042, Burrow Warrens frames walk_02_day, walk_03_day, route_day (the row's usual route args). base = tree as is; arm = plus FLOOR2-WARRENS/overlay_meadow_match.json (burrow_warrens.json bank.hill_shell.meadow_match on: meadow grass sheet on up-facing hill faces + nature-pack tufts, 1.5 m mouth pad). Pre-check: hillside visibly differs (smooth flat green shell -> textured meadow grass; mean diff 7.5-9.0); cave mouth and its brown earth rim unchanged (route_day arch identical; walk_02 lip around the opening still brown); no tuft floats or stands in the mouth; red entrance trees still red. Note: in walk_02 the hill's lower earth band left of the mouth is partly greened on its upper faces; wild creature spawn differs in walk_03 (badgers base, rock-shelled creatures arm).
